notes.title: Build 0.9.5a - Small QoL and other tweaks.
notes.notes:
Hey :)

We just released another quick update, mostly with some UI additions, some new patrols and various odds and ends.

We're adding the Turn Order bar to the deployment screen and changing the way gear on characters gets "optimized" after changing their class or passives.

Now, after changing their class (or removing passives that change their gear options, such as removing Dual Wield or Equip All for example), if the current gear has invalid entries, those entries will be removed and then filled with "the best possible option".

If a unit doesn't have any "invalid gear" after the change, their loadout will not be changed at all.

We also updated the way the best weapon is calculated to account for hybrid classes, fighting classes and magic classes.

We're adding 4 new patrols and tweaking the tuning on a few others.

There are a few bug fixes that we wanted to get out ASAP and some small balance updates as well.

From now on, the main focus will be primarily bug fixes until release and it's likely there will not be another Early Access build update until the actual Release build, on April 30th.

We'll keep reading and collecting the community's feedback as we prepare for post-release updates though :)

Thanks again!


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]04/21/2019 - Version 0.9.5a[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Patrols:[/b] Adding new patrols to Caravan Trail, Graveyard, Godstear Waste and Gelligh Foothills.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Turn Order:[/b] Will now be shown during troops placement.
[*][b]Changing Class/Passives:[/b] Will not run "optimize gear" anymore but instead "optimize invalid gear", which will will call optimize only for pieces of gear that need to be unequipped with the new class/passive.
[*][b]Optimizing Gear:[/b] Will now be better about equipping the right type of weapon, choosing the best weapon between ATK, MND and ATK+MND based on the main class.
[*][b]Sorting by Level:[/b] Will now use EXP as the second sorting parameters to differentiate units with the same Level.
[*][b]Gelligh Battle 2:[/b] Updating shown objective to make it clear Kyrie must survive.
[*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] Minor adjustments to many cutscenes.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Initiative:[/b] Character will no longer get a "bonus to the time gauge" if taking no action on their Initiative-granted turn.
[*][b]Skyjack:[/b] Now cannot miss. It was always meant to be this way, so it's technically a bug fix.
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI will value more accurately MP granting/draining abilities.
[*][b]Gelligh Battle 2:[/b] Enemy items usage is now disabled. Slightly adjusting the extra enemies to be a little more managable.
[*][b]Vangals AI:[/b] Many Vangals, Thervas and Daodrenners have had their default AI behavior change to be more aggressive and less prone to heal.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Pounce:[/b] Fixed an issue where characters could jump "outside the bounds of the map".
[*][b]Rebirth:[/b] Rebirth would not trigger of the character died from thorn damage or from Turnabout damage. Fixed.
[*][b]Exhausted:[/b] Could be prevented by Barrier even though it's supposed to ignore all forms of debuffs removal/prevention. Fixed.
[*][b]Shoving:[/b] Will now correctly grant killing blow exp on the second target and when drowning targets.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Added missing frames to the Ghost sprite and fixed some Bzil accessories that had some issues.
[*][b]Blazing Bolas:[/b] Fixing a rare issue where the trap could spawn in a weird location.
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Fixing a few small layering issues in some maps.
[*][b]Turn Order HP:[/b] The bar will correctly update the user HP after canceling a movement where Life Font gave them HP.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Jobs.xml:[/b] Adding a new field to classes: casterClass, with values 0: not a caster, 1: caster, 2: hybrid. This will be used when optimizing gear, rather than the old IsAMagicClass from GameOptions.txt (which is now removed).
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.9.5 - New difficulty setting, visuals, balance...
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/c5f2b986b1e0de9f709515165757b0b15c06d0fc.jpg[/img]
[I]In case you missed it, our Release trailer is up on our Steam page![/I]

[h1]New build:[/h1]
We have another build this week and once again, it's one of our biggest updates yet.

We've been working on the final balance changes and various loose ends, so the changes are all over the place, but there's a lot new stuff!

Here are the highlights:
[list]
[*][b]Difficulty Setting:[/b] The "Extra Enemies" setting has a new option called "Elite", which will add/replace some enemies on many maps. The new enemies are custom-made to be dangerous. This should increase the difficulty quite a bit and is meant as an alternative to make the game harder, other than +Stats% on enemies. Enemies added by this mode will have the "Elite" tag rather than "Enemy" on their info panel. A BIG thank you to Dabor for this!
[*][b]Title screen:[/b] Switching to the Animated Titlescreen we've been preparing for a while. Big thanks to Brodie Swift who created it!
[*][b]Exclusive Fullscreen:[/b] Adding an option to enable Exclusive Fullscreen.
[*][b]New Assets:[/b] We have a new character portrait, haircut and some revamped portraits for many NPCs, as well as new spell visuals and sounds. We also added ambient props to a lot of maps.
[*][b]Balance:[/b] We have a bunch of new balance updates again, including tweaks to some passives the community has been feeling needed love, such as:
[list]
[*][b]Focused Rage:[/b] Is now an action command (like Double Casting), so the player can choose to use it or not.
[*][b]Hallowed Mind:[/b] Now a new passive: grants bonus damage on the next action after using a Regular Attack.
[*][b]+Damage Passives:[/b] Adjusted a lot of their numbers.
[/list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] Various AI updates and improvements.
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Monsters will have their tier increased automatically in patrols. To tier 2 if their average level is 20 or more and to tier 3 if the average level is 30 or more.
[*][b]A lot more![/b] Seriously, there's a lot of changes in this one! You can see them all at the end of the update.
[/list]

[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
This should actually be our last big update before release. At this point, we'll be focusing on fixing any bugs that are found, some polish and a few modding additions. This week was spent wrapping up everything and testing everything. It's looking very solid and we're happy with where [I]Fell Seal[/I] is standing right now!

Even though we're pretty much done with all the features for the game for Release, it doesn't mean we're not hoping to keep getting everyone's feedback!
We'll keep fixing bugs and adjusting things after Release and if there is enthusiasm from the community, there's a good chance we'll start looking at some DLC options as well. So, keep the feedback coming please! :)

[h1]State of the Early Access:[/h1]
With our [I]Early Access[/I] closing soon, it's a good time to take stock of things and we have to admit we've been very happy with the experience.
All in all, it's been very positives, and I would say that the feedback and support of everyone alone has made this an incredibly fruitful [I]Early Access[/I] for us, and we think [I]Fell Seal[/I] is a [b]much better[/b] game for it!

Once again, a very big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone for all the feedback and support!


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]04/19/2019 - Version 0.9.5[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Difficulty Setting:[/b] The "Extra Enemies" setting has a new option called "Elite", which will add/replace some enemies on many maps. The new enemies are custom-made to be dangerous. This should increase the difficulty quite a bit and is meant as an alternative to make the game harder, other than +Stats% on enemies. Enemies added by this mode will have the "Elite" tag rather than "Enemy" on their info panel. A BIG thank you to Dabor for this!
[*][b]Title screen:[/b] Switching to the Animated Titlescreen we've been preparing for a while. Big thanks to Brodie Swift who created it!
[*][b]Exclusive Fullscreen:[/b] Adding an option to enable Exclusive Fullscreen.
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] Adding 1 new female portrait.
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] Updating the portraits of some story villains.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Adding a dozen or so missing sounds. We are now fully done with sounds.
[*][b]Visual Effects:[/b] Adding the last remaining missing visual effects. We are now done with those.
[*][b]Troops Menu:[/b] When in combat, deployed units will be shown in the "casting" motion in the Troops menu so they can be spotted quickly.
[*][b]Iirzkt'ara Gorge:[/b] Adding a new patrol to this map.
[*][b]Ambient Props:[/b] More ambient props added to various maps.
[*][b]Character Customization:[/b] A new haircut was added for male/female characters.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Monsters will have their tier increased automatically in patrols. To tier 2 if their average level is 20 or more and to tier 3 if the average level is 30 or more.
[*][b]Vessel:[/b] Changing Hallowed Mind to a new passive: grants bonus damage on the next action after using a Regular Attack (after using a melee attack: 45% bonus, after using a ranged regular attack: 35%).
[*][b]Pandora's Box:[/b] Will now be 'smarter' about what is used and try to favor using an ability that works better with the ATK or MND stats of the caster. It's still random, but it's skewed a bit to be 'better'.
[*][b]Sunder:[/b] Now works like Chilling Touch and Deep Wounds: it will apply to any offensive action and have less chance of hitting per target the more targets the attack has.
[*][b]Sunken Ship:[/b] The guest in this balance will now have a Pure Band to protect against Poison.
[*][b]Very Hard:[/b] Changing the presets to enable Elite enemies. Lowering the +Stats to 10% (from 25%) to compensate.
[*][b]Boss Levels:[/b] Many bosses would bypass the "story level cap" even without that specific difficulty setting. Fixed.
[*][b]4th Temple:[/b] Lowering the level of the boss characters a little bit, on top of the above fix about boss levels something not getting capped.
[*][b]Focused Rage:[/b] Is now an action command (like Double Casting), so the player can choose to use it or not. It will not work with Infused Edge anymore though.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Various improvements to the AI.
[list]
[*]Better AI for Tangrels, Malcubus.
[*]Taking better account of various counters, including less likely to "kill themselves" via Counterattack/etc.
[*]AI will now make use of Sabotage.
[*]AI will now make use of Pile On and Refresh.
[*]AI could have some strange behaviors with Collect abilities on rare occasions. Fixed.
[/list]
[*][b]Optional Story Character:[/b] A certain optional story character that joins late in the game will now start with 15% more AP on his classes.
[*][b]Story Character:[/b] A certain story character that joins fairly late will now start with a little more AP than before on certain classes.
[*][b]Sorcerer:[/b] Reducing the AP needed for most abilities.
[*][b]Leech MP:[/b] Adding a cap of 15 MP leeched maximum per regular attack. Leeched amount cannot be negative anymore (due to elemental resistances, etc).
[*][b]Siphon:[/b] Adding a cap of 25 MP drained maximum. Can't yield a negative amount anymore (it probably couldn't before in practice).
[*][b]Versatile:[/b] Adding a cap of 15 MP for the amount of MP restored on a crit.
[*][b]Poison Swamp:[/b] Will now be prevented by Barrier. Also won't refresh the duration on every turn spent in the poison anymore, but only on the turn it wears off.
[*][b]Pounce:[/b] Pounce will now try all 4 possible positions around the target, favoring the closest, rather than just the closest. Damage ignores direction and uses the real autoattack of the unit (which means it will use Dual Wielding and apply weapons effects).
[*][b]Malice:[/b] Will now correctly apply to Chilling Touch, Sunder and Deep Wounds.
[*][b]Somier's Rescue:[/b] No enemies will spawn with boots anymore.
[*][b]Charm:[/b] The Charm ability on the Vampire class is now "not a spell, not a skill" rather than a spell. It means it won't work with double cast and infused edge anymore, but now won't be prevented by mute.
[*][b]+Damage Passives:[/b] Adjusted a lot of their numbers.
[list]
[*]Eruptor: Increasing the bonus each turn from 10% to 18% and the cap to 72%.
[*]Blood Mark: Adding a cap at 80%.
[*]Into the Fray: Damage for 2 targets increased to 32% (from 30%).
[*]Height Advantage: Cap increased to 40% (from 35%).
[*]Perfect Body: Bonus reduced to 32% (from 35%).
[*]Avenger: Increasing damage reduction to 12.5% per stack (from 10%).
[*]Execute: Increasing bonus to 45% (from 40%).
[*]Legendary Healer: Reducing bonus to 45% (from 50%). Also adding the value to the GameOptions.txt.
[*]Stampede: Adding a cap of 60%.
[/list]
[*][b]Rain of Arrows/Rain of Spines:[/b] Greatly increasing the Vert range and AoE Vert range to make it easier to use.
[*][b]Bzaro:[/b] Will now get bonus AP from slaying Bzils, for the class that Bzil was using. Since Bzaro doesn't get Essences from Bzils, he will only get this bonus AP if he's already learned the class.
[*][b]One for All:[/b] Now, melee attacks made by One for All will do 1x damage and Ranged attacks will do 0.75x damage.
[*][b]Turnabout:[/b] Turnabout and similar counters (where the target explodes on death) will not trigger if the target is defeated by a counter ability anymore, to add more counter-play.
[*][b]Arena:[/b] Arena enemies will no longer be able to spawn with "unique gear" (that was technically a bug).
[*][b]Lich:[/b] The player can now get the class a little earlier: exchanging the special treasures from The swamp and the ship.
[*][b]Vessel:[/b] The player can now get the class much earlier: exchanging the special treasures from the forest with that of the canyon.
[*][b]Worms Fight:[/b] The player will have more time to move out of the big ground effect that signals the arrival of a certain boss.
[*][b]Patrols:[/b] Now, when running a patrol on a map, until the player has seen all the patrol possible for that map, the "next patrol" will be automatically selected. Once all have been seen, they will become randomized as before. This should help the player see all the possible patrols for all maps. This is not retroactive.
[*][b]Interstich:[/b] The boss that uses Interstitch will now have lessened chances of using it (or Teleport Other).
[*][b]Lockets:[/b] Increasing the DEF/RES lockets values (36 to 48) and reducing speed locket value (30 to 20).
[*][b]Daggers:[/b] Reducing Flash Knife (25 to 20) speed and Dragon's Nail speed (16 to 13).
[*][b]Cap of Ages:[/b] Reducing Speed from 13 to 8.
[*][b]Gear:[/b] Very minor tweak to some speed stats (we changed the rounding method for the speed stats on gear so some might gain 1 speed).
[*][b]Gogombob City:[/b] Adding a pair of hover boots on one enemy to patrol0.
[*][b]Henge Battle:[/b] Adjustments to the enemy AI and gear and to the guest's gear to give the guest character an easier time. Also giving the guest a subclass, a counter and some extra passives for the encounter to make it a little easier.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Class Mastery:[/b] The first time the user masters a class, a quick tutorial popup will mention permanent stats are granted.
[*][b]Help Compendium:[/b] Smoothing out transitions to and from the Help Compendium so it looks better.
[*][b]Descriptions:[/b] Updating a few descriptions with more information.
[*][b]Guest Characters:[/b] Will now try to use the "generic enemy portrait made for the player" and if they can't find one, use a "non enemy portrait".
[*][b]Patrols:[/b] Adding a confirmation popup before running a Patrol to reduce the chances of accidentally starting one.
[*][b]Details Button:[/b] Adding a tutorial about the Details button for the first time the player sees a "delayed attack" (ie, in the Worms battle).
[*][b]Bandit Kawas:[/b] Giving them a new color so they look a little less "friendly".
[*][b]Colored Tiles:[/b] Updating the priority of ordered tiles so the "starting position" tiles are shown over the "passage tiles" to be clearer.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]First Boss:[/b] When playing with extra enemies, the battle will now end after killing the boss, as intended (rather than needing to kill all enemies).
[*][b]Injuries[/b] A drowned unit wouldn't get an injury correctly under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Mirage:[/b] Fixing some strange interactions between Mirage and drowning.
[*][b]Bandit Kawa:[/b] There were still some issues where the Kawas would have odd behavior after moving (untargetable, etc). This should be fixed for good this time, although they will be more passive than before.
[*][b]Counterattack/Countershot:[/b] Will now correctly check for vertical height after getting pushed back (by Forceful Strike, etc) to ensure the counter attack is still valid.
[*][b]Worms:[/b] Counter Critical:Haste wasn't granting Haste correctly and had some issues in the description. fixed.
[*][b]Abilities Range:[/b] When using a Staff, sometimes the ability range in the ability description would be showing wrong values. Fixed.
[*][b]Collect Trophy:[/b] It had the wrong min range value. Fixed.
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI would still cast Quicken on allies with the Exhaust debuff at times. Fixed.
[*][b]Traps:[/b] With certain abilities (Bolas, Forceful Strike, etc), a trap could trigger at the end of the sequence even though the target was dead. Fixed.
[*][b]Quicken:[/b] Fixing a few weird issues when quickening multiple targets each turn with doublecast, including quickening the caster.
[*][b]Outfits:[/b] Adding missing "special outfits" to the list of outfits generated sprites can't spawn with.
[*][b]Wildcards: Diamond:[/b] Fixing an issue where Haste would be granted almost all the time as a buff.
[*][b]Save files:[/b] The save files could fail to load correctly if the user has an unrecognized timezone. I admit I'm not sure how that would ever happen, but stranger things have happened. Fixed.
[*][b]Large Enemies:[/b] Back/Side/Front attacks status was weirdly calculated on large enemies. It should now feel more natural.
[*][b]Thorns:[/b] Thorns will now correctly reflect damage for both attacks (grouped as 1 reflection) when taking damage from dual wielding attackers. Thorns will now correctly reflect damage for the spell part when taking damage from Infused Edge.
[*][b]Descriptions:[/b] Fixing some tooltip descriptions that had imprecise information (like Blood Magic).
[*][b]Old Armor:[/b] Anadine now correctly starts the game wearing the Old Armor.
[*][b]AI Double Cast:[/b] Fixing some small odd interactions between counters and the AI using Double Cast. AI will also not try to Double Cast on a target that has Counter:Mute unless it's immune to Mute.
[*][b]Hover Boots:[/b] Equipping or removing Hover boots at the start of a battle will correctly start the character with the "floating visuals".
[*][b]Reanimate:[/b] Was granting too much EXP, equivalent to a killing blow. Fixed to yield regular EXP now.
[*][b]Guardian Sword:[/b] Now correctly flagged as Unique and won't be equipped by enemies unless they can equip uniques.
[*][b]Ability Learn:[/b] The list to select the the class to learn abilities from could get messy under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[*][b]Gelligh:[/b] After the city gets in a bit of trouble, the map used had a house shown over some units weirdly. Fixed.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixing some UI layouts that weren't correct in other languages than English.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] Armor, Helmet, Shield slots can now be used for monsters/bzils as well and filled with accessories. They can technically be filled with "non-accessories", but it might cause problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Retroactive achievements (0.9.4a)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We released achievements yesterday, but it's been brought to our attention that not enough of them were retroactive.

We're pushing a small update today (0.9.4a) which should have almost all achievements be retroactive upon loading a save file.

If one of them isn't retroactive, feel free to drop us a line on the forums, but chances are that it's normal, as there are a very small amount that aren't retroactive. There are 8 (out of 43) non-retroactive achievements, including 6 "in-combat achievements", 1 trivial-to-unlock, and 1 crafting related.


That's the only change for the new build, so no patch notes this time!

Let us know how it goes!

notes.title: Build 0.9.4 - Achievements and Cloud saves
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/d674f506636d302342d70a4bbd026926163adbe1.png[/img]
[I]Achievements![/I]

[h1]New Bulid:[/h1]
This week's build's main attraction is Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves!

There are 43 achievements in game, including 22 "hidden achievements". Many are going to be retroactive and trigger after loading a game and messing around a little bit, but not all of them. In general, those that aren't retroactive are either very easy to obtain or involve doing something specific during a battle (that's repeatable, so you can't miss it).
Also, the cloud saves could require a Steam restart to kick in.

Let us know how it all works out!

Here are the highlights:
[list]
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Achievements are now enabled. Those are retroactive for the most part, although some specific combat ones (like killing an enemy by drowning them for example) will have to be done again to be obtained.
[*][b]Cloud Saves:[/b] Cloud saves should now be enabled. Everything should be working fine, but it's something a little new for us, so let us know if you notice anything weird!  (Cloud saves are not enabled on Linux sadly).
[*][b]Balance:[/b] Various small updates to the balance, including tweaks to specific encounters, small adjustments to some growths from feedback from last week's changes, tweaks to some gear, etc.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Lots of bug fixes from internal testing and from forums feedback. Thanks again to everyone taking the time to let us know about bugs!
[/list]


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
We finally finished our last [i]Ancient Path[/i] map work and now all the content for the game is finished!
We're still going to keep polishing and updating balance and bug fixing for a while though, of course!
Otherwise, we finished our Steam integration: cloud saves and achievements have been added to the game. Collectibles and badges should also already be tied to the game as well.


[h1]Change logs:[/h1]
[u]04/12/2019 - Version 0.9.4[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Achievements are now enabled. Those are retroactive for the most part, although some specific combat ones (like killing an enemy by drowning them for example) will have to be done again to be obtained.
[*][b]Cloud Saves:[/b] Cloud saves should now be enabled. Everything should be working fine, but it's something a little new for us, so let us know if you notice anything weird!
[*][b]Gogombob City:[/b] Adding a new patrol to the area.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] Improving some interactions between the mouse and keyboard on the map screen.
[*][b]Battle Map:[/b] Made things a little more responsive when navigating between the map and a menu.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Mender:[/b] Increasing HP growth a bit.
[*][b]Exemplar:[/b] Will not copy buffs granted by gear anymore, only those obtained through combat.
[*][b]Mastery Bonus:[/b] Slightly adjusting bonuses for Reaver, Werewolf, Lich, Mercenary, Knight and Gadgeteer.
[*][b]Restful Stones:[/b] Vangal will not spawn with boots anymore. Changing 1 Assassin to only spawn on higher difficulties.
[*][b]Bosses and Leaders:[/b] Now will never use "sacrifice" types of abilities.
[*][b]Bandit Kawa:[/b] Will now never spawn with boots.
[*][b]Maces:[/b] Now have a crit chance.
[*][b]Enemies:[/b] Updated tables for generating counters/passives to reflect all the recent balance updates. Moved the "evasion %" passive to later levels to reduce early game evasion bonuses.
[*][b]Rings:[/b] Pure Band lost its speed bonus. Shinning Band got +2 speed.
[*][b]Daodrenner:[/b] Reducing evasion of tier1 to 5 (from 10). Reducing evasion of tier 2 to 7 (from 10). Bzil form evasion reduced to 7 (from 10).
[*][b]Enemies:[/b] Will know various tiers of their skill trees just a little later than before in terms of levels.
[*][b]Strong Abilities:[/b] Some abilities are obtained a little later by enemies than they normally would (Sniper Shot, Assassinate, Righteous Blade). Adding Dual Casting to that list and adding individual levels (rather than 1 level for all of those) for better control.
[*][b]Chilling Touch, Deep Wounds:[/b] Changing the passives to work with all offensive actions. The more targets in the zone, the less chance to succeed per target (the combined probability will always be the same amount regardless of the amount of targets).
[*][b]Tournament 2:[/b] Some tweaks to some encounters.
[*][b]Arena:[/b] Changing the AP/GP bonus to 40% (from 33%).
[*][b]Bosses:[/b] Certain bosses could ignore the level range of encounters, this has been changed so they will be within the level range of the encounter.
[*][b]Worms:[/b] Changing their counter from "Haste" to "Critical: Haste" (it used to be Critical: Haste but the recent change transforming it to "Haste" affected the worms as well, so we reverted their counter.)
[*][b]Worms:[/b] Will now never spawn with Poison or Bleed immunities.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Worms AI:[/b] Fixing an interaction that could be off when a target would be immune to roots.
[*][b]Typos:[/b] Fixing some typos in some ability descriptions and dialogue.
[*][b]Protect:[/b] Offensive skills "centered on the caster" would bypass Protect on targets. Fixed.
[*][b]AI Dual Casting:[/b] Fixing some instances where the AI would still cast its 2nd spell even if a counter killed it after the 1st spell.
[*][b]Map Placement:[/b] The triggers to switch between enemies would sometimes not work correctly during map placement of some story battles. Fixed.
[*][b]Enemies:[/b] Fixing rare cases of invalid classes or subclasses for certain human enemies.
[*][b]Lever 99:[/b] Certain actions would still award EXP even after reaching the level cap and gaining a level past the cap would enter an infinite level-up loop. Both issues are fixed.
[*][b]Dark Resist:[/b] All units in the game would automatically master a special boss class and gain various stats, including Dark restistance 5. Fixed.
[*][b]Obelisks:[/b] One of the Obelisks wouldn't show its activated sprite after being activated. Fixed.
[*][b]Fleet of Foot:[/b] Fixing the information panel not showing correctly the updated movement.
[*][b]Status Effects:[/b] Upon removing a status effect on a target, abilities that interact with the "amount of status effects" on the target would still count it as active until the target got its next turn. Fixed.
[*][b]Turn Order:[/b] When reviving someone, selecting a unit on the map to view their stats would sometimes fail to show them correctly in the turn order. Fixed.
[*][b]Info Placard:[/b] Fixing an issue where the "other pages" buttons would become visible when they shouldn't.
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] When using the mouse scroll to switch between 2 overlapping tiles, changing tiles with the keyboard or gamepad would leave the cursor "shown on top of everything". Fixed.
[*][b]Help:[/b] Fixing an issue where the help tooltips would be partially outside the screen for certain resolutions.
[*][b]Bandit Kawa:[/b] Fixing a rare issue where they could spawn on an invalid location in the Restful Stones.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Fixing some odd AI decisions with Shadowstrike.
[*][b]Side Effects:[/b] Fixing an issue where Side Effects would cause damage when granting Quick due to the Exhausted debuff.
[*][b]Armors on Enemies:[/b] On rare occasions, some unique armors that aren't supposed to be on enemies would still spawn on them. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.9.3 - Huge Balance Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/c9000e780854f56e1ada8aeea7c507cff88a7ec6.png[/img]
[I]Visible traps will now adjust pathfinding so the player can tell where they can really walk to. None of the paths will walk on a visible trap, unless the player selects the trap itself as the destination.[/I]

[h1]New Build:[/h1]
We have another update this week. This time the focus was almost entirely on [b]Balance [/b]and there are a lot of changes all over ([i]about a 100 different line items[/i]). The main goal was to bring "up to par" various class growths, passives and counters, as well as resolving some abusable combos (around quicken and evasion mostly).
Oh, and we updated the pathfinding to account for visible traps now too :)

The patch notes are quite lengthy this time around, but here's the rough highlights:
[list]
[*][b]Traps avoidance:[/b] When a trap is made visible by the player, the pathfinding will update to block paths that can't be reached anymore (because the trap would interrupt the player). The player can still decide to walk right on top of the trap, but that's the only way they'll hit a trap, as none of paths shown will walk on it.
[*][b]Class Growths:[/b] Most growths were slightly adjusted to bring up classes that were lacking and bring down some classes that had growths quite a bit better than others.
[*][b]Passives/Counters:[/b] A number of passives and counters were changed or removed. Some new passives were added to replace them.
[*][b]Quicken:[/b] There were various scenarios involiving infinite turns with Quicken. This should be fixed for the most part (it might still be possible to cheese things partially with Critical Quicken, but it's quite risky and involved, so we're not touching that one).
[*][b]Thorns:[/b] Redid the way calculations are done for Thorns damage. The damage will now be based on the targets DEF stat (the target of the thorn damage) rather than be a portion of the damage dealt to the thorn-user. This will make it so high defense units won't do weaker thorn damage anymore. Thorn reflection ratio changed to 0.25x (from 0.35x) to compensate for this.
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] By popular demand, adding more of the enemy portraits to the list avaible to the player. I believe pretty much all of them are available now, with a blue color rather than red to limit confusion.
[/list]

That's really only a small subset of the changes we added this patch. The full list is at the end of this post.

Also, we're not done with balance, as we still have pages of changes we want to get in.

Please, keep the feedback and comments coming in the Forums, as the end of April is approaching fast!
We'd also like to mention that while we don't answer all the posts on the Forums about balance/etc, we read all of them and the feedback is very appreciated (even if we don't act on all of it)!


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
We've mostly worked on balance this week, as can be seen from the patch notes. But we've also put more work on the Ancient Path and wrapped up all the the loot and treasures in that place. The only thing missing is some special AI code for one of the levels and it should be done. We expect it to be done next week, which will make all the content finished.


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]04/05/2019 - Version 0.9.3[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Traps avoidance:[/b] When a trap is made visible by the player, the pathfinding will update to block paths that can't be reached anymore (because the trap would interrupt the player). The player can still decide to walk on top of the trap, but that's the only way they'll hit a trap, as none of paths shown will walk on it.
[*][b]Soul Binder:[/b] Soul Binder will now correctly trigger the 100% Charm chance if the target is asleep, as well as trigger Mind Control on the target.
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] By popular demand, adding more of the enemy portraits to the list avaible to the player. I believe pretty much all of them are available now, with a blue color rather than red to limit confusion.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Adding forgotten visuals for Pick Off and Rusty Stab.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Sturdy Grip:[/b] Now also allows for shield usage as well as equipping a 2H with 1 hand.
[*][b]Into the Fray:[/b] Slightly adjusted the value for "2 enemies in range".
[*][b]Health Siphon:[/b] Increasing range to 2 to better match the rest of the Fellblade's abilities.
[*][b]Alchemystic:[/b]
[list]
[*]Insight: Spell now costs 8 MP and has 3 range like other Alchemystic buffs.
[*]Fortitude: Passive has been moved to the Plague Doctor.
[*]Side Effects: New Passive: When successfully applying a buff on a target, it will also heal them at 0.3x. When successfully applying a debuff to a target, it will damage them at 0.25x.
[*]Thorns: moved to Plague Doctor.
[*]Soul Tendrils: Adding a long range high damage high MP cost non-elemental spell to the Alchemystic.
[*]Reorganized Skill tree to accommodate new abilities.
[/list]
[*][b]Plague Doctor:[/b]
[list]
[*]Armor Proficiency: Removing passive. Granting Heavy Armor to the Plague Doctor to compensate.
[*]Fortitude: Armor Proficiency was replaced by Fortitude (previously on Alchemystic).
[*]Into the Fray: Moved to the Reaver.
[*]Permanence: New Passive: Buffs and Debuffs casted by this character will last 1 turn longer.
[*]Thorns: Thorn spell moved to the Plague Doctor. Spell is now an AoE and MP cost increased to 8 (from 6). Also, we redid the way Thorns damage is calculated so it won't be reduced from the user having high defenses anymore.
[*]Total Shield: spell is removed (moved to Druid).
[/list]
[*][b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Equip Shield: Passive is removed (it was fused with Sturdy Grip on the Mercenary).
[*]Resilience: New passive: debuffs applied to this character will last 1 less turn than normal (min 1).
[/list]
[*][b]Reaver:[/b]
[list]
[*]Desperate Blow: Increasing MP cost to 16 (from 6).
[*]Doublehand: Passive has been removed.
[*]Into the Fray: new passive for the Reaver (previously on Plague Doctor).
[*]Spread Pain: Will now also cause damage to the target.
[*]Primal Blow: Adding MP cost of 6.
[*]Primal Wave: Adding MP cost of 8.
[/list]
[*][b]Druid:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shield and Aegis: Replacing by Total Shield, with MP cost of 6. This should synergizes better with their Dual Casting feature.
[*]Dispel: Lowering MP cost to 6 (from 8).
[*]Counter Magic: Moving the counter on the Wizard.
[*]Adaptive Affinity: Moving the counter from the Wizard to the Druid. Also changing the way the calculations are handled so that if the caster is ever targeting himself, the "affinity" bonus will be granted before damage calculations are made.
[*]Adaptive Affinity: Now not restricted to 1 buff and a character can have 1 per element. They will last 3 turns now though.
[*]Skill Tree: Was reworked slightly since 1 ability was removed. Dual Cast was moved to a lower node as well.
[/list]
[*][b]Knight:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chivalrous Spirit: Lowering MP cost to 18 (from 22).
[/list]
[*][b]Vessel:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hallowed Body: Changing the passive from: +15% to ATK/MND to: +20% of ATK to MND and +20% of MND to ATK.
[*]Spells: Increasing damage a bit for some spells, to better compensate for high costs.
[*]Psyhie: now restores only 5 MP, but MP cost lowered to 18 (from 22).
[/list]
[*][b]Weaken:[/b] Now lasts 3 turns (from 2). Now is removed by Regenerate and Balm as well as other abilities that removed it before.
[*][b]Evasion:[/b] Evasion can easily reach high numbers, especially for the player, and it presents too easy an opportunity to "cheese" things.
[list]
[*]Cap: Adding a hard cap to the evasion stat of 50%.
[*]Gear: Reducing evasion of most gear pieces. Specifically, Main Gauche, Shields, Cap of Ages, and Exo Gloves had their evasion reduced, but many other small tweaks.
[*]Passive: Reducing evasion from the passive to 13 (from 15).
[/list]
[*][b]Debuffs:[/b] When applying debuffs, the debuffs from the selected ability will be applied last (so, weapons, passives, etc, will come first) to give the user more control over which debuff will get absorbed by Barrier. This is a fairly advanced feature to be honest.
[*][b]Thorns:[/b] Redid the way calculations are done for Thorns damage. The damage will now be based on the targets DEF stat (the target of the thorn damage) rather than be a portion of the damage dealt to the thorn-user. This will make it so high defense units won't do weaker thorn damage anymore. Thorn reflection ratio changed to 0.25x (from 0.35x) to compensate for this.
[*][b]Quicken:[/b] There were various scenarios involiving infinite turns with Quicken. This should be fixed for the most part (it might still be possible to cheese things partially with Critical Quicken, but it's quite risky and involved, so we're not touching that one).
[list]
[*]Using Quicken on a character will give them the debuff "Exhausted", which will prevent further Quicken spells from affecting them until it wears off. It will wear off the next time they get a "natural turn". Counter: Critical Quicken ignores the debuff (so it will always trigger if the critical condition is met), but will still give the debuff to the unit.
[*]Self: Because of the above debuff, Quicken can now be casted on "Self" again.
[/list]
[*][b]Class Growths:[/b] Small update to stats growth to get up-to-date with recent balance changes. All changes are very small amounts unless specified. None of these changes are retroactive (ie, current stats will not change).
[list]
[*]Sorcerer: HP up, Res up, Spd up, Atk up, Def up.
[*]Reaver: HP down, Res up.
[*]Demon Knight: Def down, Res down, MP down, HP down.
[*]Assassin: Atk up, HP up.
[*]Wizard: Atk up, HP up.
[*]Lord: MP down, Res down, Def down.
[*]Ranger: Hp up.
[*]Mercenary: MP up.
[*]Gadgeteer: HP down, Def down, Res down.
[*]Knight: Res down.
[*]Vampire: Mp up.
[*]Plague Doctor: Mp down, Def down, Mnd up.
[*]Warmage: HP up, MP down, Spd up.
[*]Fellblade: HP down, Atk Up, Spd down.
[*]Alchemystic: Spd up (a fair amount), Res down, Mnd up.
[*]Peddler: MP up, Hp Up, Res Down.
[*]Vessel: Hp down, Atk Up, Def up, Res up, Spd up.
[*]Lich: Large changes for this one. HP up, MP down, Def down, Res down. Atk up.
[*]Anatomist: Spd up, Atk up, HP up.
[*]Princess: Spd up, Res down, MP up, Atk up.
[*]Spymaster: MP up, HP up.
[*]Exiled: MP up.
[*]Marked: Mp up.
[*]Scoundrel: MP up.
[*]Druid: MP down, Res down, Spd up.
[*]Mender: Spd up.
[/list]
[*][b]Princess:[/b] Reordered the skill tree around significantly and changed some AP costs a bit.
[*][b]Counter Shield/Counter Aegis:[/b] Now became Counter Total Shield.
[*][b]Crossbows:[/b] Increased attack values a tiny bit for all of them. Adding a small accuracy bonus to all of them as well. Increasing existing MND bonus to those that had one and added a MND bonus to Aerolus.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Made AI smarter with Infused Edge in general.
[*][b]Counter Haste:[/b] Was changed from Critical: Haste to Haste, so it will now proc from being attacked, rather from being at critical health. This might be a little too strong, so we'll keep an eye on it.
[*][b]Light Armors:[/b] Making tiny adjustments to Lorica Musculata and Lorica Mentis (higher offensive bonus, lower RES) and to Golden Garb (small MND bonus).
[*][b]Pick Off:[/b] Reducing base damage to 1.6x (from 1.7x). Increasing the reduction for "nearby ally" to 0.6x (from 0.4x).
[*][b]Gadgeteer:[/b] Changing the damage type of certain gadgets to Mixed and certain to ATK (most were MND before).
[*][b]Daggers:[/b] Reducing speed bonus of Flash Knife and Dragon's Nail.
[*][b]Swords:[/b] Increasing MND bonus of swords with a MND bonus a tad. Giving a small speed bonus to Eternias.
[*][b]Spears:[/b] Increasing MND bonus of spears with a MND bonus a tad. Godray's stats bonus were slightly increased.
[*][b]Scythes:[/b] Reaper now has a small MND bonus.
[*][b]Maces:[/b] Increasing their MND bonus.
[*][b]Guns:[/b] Adding a small MND bonus to Hell Muzzle.
[*][b]Staves:[/b] Reducing MND and DEF bonus for Godsleg.
[*][b]Archafflictor:[/b] Replacing Reanimator with Plaguestorm, a spell that deals damage and has a chance to inflict a random debuff on all enemies.
[*][b]Archafflictor:[/b] Reducing AI odds of using items a little bit for this monster.
[*][b]Scoundrel:[/b] Making Fleet Of Foot an AoE around the caster rather than self target.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Into the Fray:[/b] Tooltip has been updated to show that it applies to damage and healing.
[*][b]Various Spell Names:[/b] Renamed many spells to Mass "name" to be more consistent with the naming scheme.
[*][b]Stats Growth:[/b] Making layout a little easier to read.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI wasn't valuing using Panacea the way it should, so it almost never bothered. Should be fixed, but we'll have to keep an eye out to ensure the AI isn't too trigger-happy about this now.
[*][b]Sunder:[/b] Passive wasn't being applied correctly in general.
[*][b]Blood Mark:[/b] Will not be applied to "fixed damage" anymore.
[*][b]Bandit Kawas:[/b] There were instances where Bandit Kawas would take a movement action that was a little weird (such as moving on top of other units or moving before a counter would trigger, etc). Fixed.
[*][b]Sleep Visuals:[/b] The visuals would be shown over/under the target oddly before. Now they are always correctly over the target.
[*][b]Revival:[/b] The camera would move to where the target died, rather than where it would be revived. Fixed.
[*][b]Leeching HP/MP:[/b] Even when missing, it would still leech HP/MP. Fixed.
[*][b]Mirage:[/b] Fixing various interactions with Mirage, including not gaining EXP in some cases when removing Mirage with an attack from a target.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Adding some GameConfig.txt options to help the few users having some weird flickering. Adding "Vsynccount=" and "targetframerate=" properties to the Graphics tab.
[*][b]Class Mastery:[/b] Mastered classes that the character doesn't have full access to yet (from being recruited in an advanced class) will still correctly grant their mastery bonus now.
[*][b]Floating:[/b] Fixing a rare instance where the floating animation would disappear from a unit.
[*][b]Countershot:[/b] The damage prediction box would show it as active even if the weapon range wasn't good enough (even though the counter would correctly not trigger).
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]GearFill:[/b] Adding "noboots" an a gearfill option. It will prevent any accessories with a move or jump component from being place on the unit by the randomizer.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.9.2 - Big UI update, Balance update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/261f3305c6e4e67c6d011acc94ece80108d1288b.png[/img]
[I]New looks for information placard.[/I]

[h1]New Build:[/h1]
Hello everyone!

This week, we've been focusing on [b]UI updates[/b] and [b]more balance updates[/b].
Actually, pretty much all the visuals for the UI were redone and we think they're looking better than ever. Give it a look and let us know what you think!

Here are the highlights for this week:
[list]
[*][b]UI:[/b] We redid most of the visual components of the UI to give them a slicker look. Adjusted some colors and positions here and there to look better as well.
[*][b]Class Mastery:[/b] Adding Class Mastery to the game. For each class mastered, the character will receive a permanent bonus to various stats (the class doesn't need to be selected for the bonus to apply). You can see the bonuses in the Class selection screen.
[*][b]Town Art:[/b] Adding town art when the player selects a town node on the world map.
[*][b]Class Select:[/b] Adding a button to view the character's Abilities of the selected class in the Class Wheel menu, for classes that are discovered.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/450c5d65efb1123f450f2e643dd9c4bf217c9708.png[/img]
We finally added the Town art to the worldmap. It'll be visible when selecting a town node.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/8f01ce5790ccabe434abc89a381221e8656f5477.png[/img]
The biggest change to the game balance is probably the "mastery bonus" we've added. When a character masters a class, they get a small permanent stats bonus from then on (even without using said class).


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
We've been quite busy this week, as usual. On top of the above changes, we've also been working on the [i]Ancient Path [/i]dungeon and we have 1 more encounter left to create for it before it's all finished!

Otherwise, lots of bug fixes, balance changes and some UI improvements. There's still a lot of balance tweaks we want to get in and a few more UI upgrades as well.


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]03/29/2019 - Version 0.9.2[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]UI:[/b] We redid most of the visual components of the UI to give them a slicker look. Adjusted some colors and positions here and there to look better as well.
[*][b]Class Mastery:[/b] Adding Class Mastery to the game. For each class mastered, the character will receive a permanent bonus to various stats (the class doesn't need to be selected for the bonus to apply). You can see the bonuses in the Class selection screen.
[*][b]Town Art:[/b] Adding town art when the player selects a town node on the world map.
[*][b]Class Select:[/b] Adding a button to view the character's Abilities of the selected class in the Class Wheel menu, for classes that are discovered.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Help:[/b] Darkening the rest of the screen when showing the help screen, to make things a little more visible.
[*][b]Abilities Descriptions:[/b] Clarifying some descriptions, including Sabotage, Snapback, Flip Kick. Adding numbers to passives that didn't have them.
[*][b]Vangaals:[/b] Renamed their ability to Alpha from Savagery (another class already uses that term).
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Height Advantage:[/b] Will now cap at 35% bonus. Bonus increased to 5% from 4% per height.
[*][b]Stats Expert:[/b] Now gives a flat amount of their STAT, based on character level. Their overall value was increased to a little over ~20% (from 15%) for ATK/MND and to ~30% for DEF/RES. These numbers might need further adjusting. This should make these passives more attractive even for characters not already stacking the STAT since it's a flat bonus.
[*][b]Doublehand:[/b] With the changes to "Stats Expert", Doublehand will need a rework, but we haven't gotten to it just yet. Soon!
[*][b]Stats Buffs:[/b] ATK/MND battle buff were increased to 20% (from 12.5%) and DEF/RES were increased to 25% (from 15%).
[*][b]Templar:[/b] New counter is Evade Attack. It evades all regular attacks (rather than just melee regular attacks).
[*][b]Ranger:[/b] New counter is Countershot. It counterattacks with a regular attack against any ranged regular attacks or skills (so, not spells).
[*][b]Life Font:[/b] Now restores 4+lv/4 HP per step, rather than 10/step. It means it will start a little weaker, but end up much stronger at high levels. In general, it should be more consistent throughout the game.
[*][b]Dirty Hit:[/b] Increasing base effect chance to 62% (from 50%).
[*][b]Hallowed Body:[/b] Increasing bonus to 15% (from 10%).
[*][b]Soul Gear:[/b] Increasing the max stacks to 60 (from 50). Reducing starting values a bit. Reducing Soul Armor "offensive bonus" by 50% per stack. Reducing Soul Eater "defensive bonus" by 50%. Reducing crit/eva/speed bonus by 50%.
[*][b]Soulreaper:[/b] Renamed to Reaper, to avoid confusion with Soul Eater.
[*][b]Oldebzar:[/b] Setting static passives on enemies that had a randomized one, for more consistency.
[*][b]Bzil Capital:[/b] Tweaking some enemies for better balance (making things slightly easier).
[*][b]Second Temple:[/b] Making one of the Rangers an "extra difficulty" enemy.
[*][b]Righteous Blade:[/b] Adding Righteous Blade to the list of abilities the AI can't use until they're at least level 30.
[*][b]Pick Off:[/b] Lowering damage from 1.8x to 1.7x.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Improving AI behavior in a few situation, including in dealing better with Mystic Shield on player units, and being smarter about dual casting buffs (not the same buff on the same target 2x).
[/list]

[h1]Bug:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Last Story Cutscene:[/b] The current "last story cutscene" was always triggering as if no "special items" had been gathered the first time the player would see it, even if they had gathered all "special items". This is fixed.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Abilities with a "Drain HP" component could be valued higher than they should by the AI. Fixed.
[*][b]Berserk:[/b] Berserk wouldn't recognize "2x2 monsters" as being closest to the Berserk target for some of their edges. Fixed.
[*][b]Skills:[/b] Skills with "counts as a regular attack" will now correctly use the status effects of the 2nd weapon as well as those of the 1st weapon.
[*][b]Evade Skills:[/b] Will now correctly prevent "Steal" abilities from working on the character.
[*][b]Tarnished Locket:[/b] Fixing an issue where a cutscene might not trigger when it should, tied to this crafting component.
[*][b]Menus:[/b] Fixing small memory leaks in some menus.
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Fixing a few more priorities-of-drawing for some maps.
[*][b]Learn Abilities:[/b] Character box would not update with new passives until after changing screen when learning a new passive on the current class. Fixed.
[*][b]Pick Off:[/b] Pick off would not work correctly on "large targets", as they would detect their own large bodies as being "nearby buddies". Fixed.
[*][b]Character Customize:[/b] Changing an existing character's visuals while they are injured would show them crouching when using the "select a sprite from the list" layout. Fixed.
[/list]


[u]03/31/2019 - Version 0.9.2a[/u]
[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Load Menu:[/b] Now showing the difficulty preset name on the load/save screen for each save file.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Teleport Other:[/b] Some enemies that should have been immune to "Teleport Other" could still be teleported away. Fixed.
[*][b]Gelligh City:[/b] One of the encounters there late game could load the wrong battle under certain circumstances. Fixed.
[/list]


[u]03/31/2019 - Version 0.9.2b[/u]
[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Character Events:[/b] Adding a small reward (Desert Garb) to one of the story-character cutscenes.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Save/Load:[/b] Fixing an issue with certain save files possibly breaking the menu.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Fixing rare cases where some special enemies would just skip their turn instead of taking an action.
[/list]


We also updated the screenshots to reflect the new UI.

notes.title: Build 0.9.1 - Big Balance Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/c1606f375e237a5e14cde11c6555ae4b336d94ca.png[/img]
[I]Those nifty town images still need to be added. Hopefully next week![/I]

[h1]New Build:[/h1]
Hello everyone!

This week's build focuses on balance changes and polish. We also have some very exciting UI updates in the works, but that'll wait until next week!

For now, balance changes to Marked, Scoundrel, Demon Knight, Fellblade and more... Most of the changes came from feedback from the community, so a big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone for helping us getting the balance ever better!

The notes for this update are actually pretty long, so the summary doesn't do them justice. Feel free to check out the full notes at the end of the post.

Highlights:
[list]
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] By popular request, adding some of the Enemy portraits (with different colors for clarity) to the list available to the player.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Substantially speeding up AI calculations in the rare cases they're not "instant".
[*][b]Intro Video:[/b] Changed the way we handle the intro video to a different format. It should be more compatible hopefully. Let us know how it goes!
[*][b]Balance:[/b] A LOT of changes, including to the stats cap, AI, Marked, Demon Knight, Fellblade, Scoundrel, many monsters, abilities, etc.
[*][b]Modding Update:[/b] The list of classes in the store will now correctly accomodate a lot of user-adder classes.
[/list]


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
This week was spent working on balance changes mostly and we made good time. Despite that, we still have a lot more to go though, with many passives, counters and weapons getting some tweaks soon. There's even more than that, but that's probably what's going to be around next week, on top of some nifty UI updates.

We've also been working on the Ancient Path, our special end-game optional dungeon and it's 50% done now. It should be finished next week, which will wrap up all optional and regular content in the game.


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]03/2/2019 - Version 0.9.1[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Portraits:[/b] By popular request, adding some of the Enemy portraits (with different colors for clarity) to the list available to the player.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] Substantially speeding up AI calculations in the rare cases they're not "instant".
[*][b]AI:[/b] In the rare cases where the AI makes a decision that takes longer than "instantly", the game could visually stutter during the process. This is now fixed.
[*][b]Intro Video:[/b] Changed the way we handle the intro video to a different format. It should be more compatible hopefully. Let us know how it goes!
[*][b]Status Effects:[/b] In the rare cases when applying the same status effects more than once with an attack, the odds will be combined into 1 odd and the effect shown only once in the prediction.
[*][b]Counters:[/b] Cleaning up camera movement during counters. Countering from "very far from the target" will lose the unnecessary "center on counter-caster" at the end of the sequence it sometimes had.
[*][b]Switcheroo:[/b] Changed visuals a little bit.
[*][b]Errors:[/b] Improving error logging a little bit so "repeated errors" don't keep getting logged.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Stats Caps:[/b]
[list]
[*]Monsters will now have their own stat cap to compensate for them relying on higher stat since they don't have equipment (currently, 700).
[/list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] New functionalities and smarter AI:
[list]
[*]The AI will now properly use Double Cast when it has it. This should be the last "big functionality" that the AI was missing and only fine tuning should remain at this point.
[*]Making the AI a little more likely to want to dispel Charm from its allies.
[*]There was an issue that made the AI slightly more likely to use hp/mp draining attacks than it normal. Fixed.
[/list]
[*][b]Marked:[/b] The main goal is to give the class more options that aren't "Dark element", since mid late game has a lot of Dark resist.
[list]
[*]Slightly adjusting AP cost of some abilities, mostly lowering them.
[*]Adding Holy Bolt, a holy version of Dark Bolt.
[*]Adding Holy Beam, a holy version of Wrathful Beam.
[*]Changed Holy Burst to do Physical damage like Wrathful Burst. Lowering the cost to 14MP, from 18MP and the damage to 1.1x (from 1.15x).
[/list]
[*][b]Demon Knight:[/b] Slightly shoring up some weaker abilities, as we feel the class is in a good spot in general.
[list]
[*]Vicious Slash: Now does 1/6th of current health rather than 1/4th.
[*]Demonic Might: Now does 1/5th of current health rather than 1/4th.
[/list]
[*][b]Fellblade:[/b] The class is in a decent spot, we're just revisiting the Skill Tree, some AP costs and small tweaks. Since the Skill tree was changed, some "learned abilities" might change a bit, but nothing that can't be fixed with a little of AP.
[list]
[*]Health Siphon: Changing the damage to ATK (from MND) and reducing the base ratio from 0.7x to 0.65x. The skill should be more effective based on ATK.
[*]Skill Tree: Moving some things around. Mainly, making Counter: Evade Magic less costly and moving it up the Skill Tree, as well as Health Siphon.
[*]Chaos Slice: Now, it will roll a random debuff taken from "any debuffs that would be valid on the target", so it should never fail to apply a debuff (unless the target is immune/afflicted by all debuffs already).
[*]Versatile: The ability was a little strong, especial at high levels. It will not restore HP anymore and the MP restore was changed to 5% (minimum 5MP) from 10% and can only happen once per spell (that part was always intended actually, so it is more of a bug fix).
[/list]
[*][b]Scoundrel:[/b] Mainly a few tweaks to give them a few more offensive options.
[list]
[*]Arterial Cut: Adding a new ability that has a chance to inflict Bleed with a 0.85x ratio. Counts as a regular attack. (Localization is not done for this yet, it'll be in the next update).
[*]Dirty Hit: Getting the "counts as a regular attack" flag as well. The idea is to give a few options to the rogue that works well with their daggers.
[*]Steal Items: Now has a 0.75x damage component. Steal abilities have a fixed "lower" chance of hitting, which mean the damage will only work if the steal is successful. An interesting side effect is that since the hit chance is fixed, it works just as well against rare "high evasion enemies".
[*]Steal Buffs: Now has a 0.75x damage component.
[*]Skill Tree: since we added an new ability, the skilltree got changed a little bit and some of the AP costs reduced to compensate having an extra one.
[/list]
[*][b]Plague Doctor:[/b] Treatment will now remove Weaken as well.
[*][b]Gambler:[/b] Changed the way Wildcards work. They will now only roll buffs/debuffs that the target doesn't already have (unless it rolled for a "bad outcome", in which case it won't work if the target already has the effect). Also changed how the better rolls work by giving "more buffs/debuffs" rather than fixed ones.
[*][b]Heavy Potion:[/b] Changing healing tiers from 200, 400 to 150, 300.
[*][b]Stampede:[/b] Reducing damage bonus from 12.5% to 10% per move.
[*][b]Undead Kawas:[/b] Their missing passive has now been set to Plaguebearer.
[*][b]Fortitude:[/b] Will now also protect from Weaken, Bleed and Poison.
[*][b]Absorb MP:[/b] Now renamed Absorb Mana and will only trigger on "offensive abilities that don't heal the target" (so, healing an ally with Fire I will not absorb the cost).
[*][b]Collect Abilities:[/b] Will now have 0% chance of success against a target that can't be collected (eg. Collect Bounty will not work on a Monster) to make it clear none of the effects will trigger on an invalid target.
[*][b]Druids:[/b] Replacing Poison with Bleed, a spell that inflicts bleeding damage rather than poison damage. The bleed effect wasn't present enough and this is a good way to give the Druid a spell other classes don't have access to.
[*][b]Desperate Blow:[/b] Now has 1 range, 3 vert range, rather than "weapon range".
[*][b]Blood Magic:[/b] Changing the ratio to 1.5%/1MP (from 1%/1MP) as it feels a little strong. We're considering moving it to 2%/1MP, but we'll see how this goes first.
[*][b]Net:[/b] Removing the MP cost (was 6).
[*][b]Enemies:[/b]Slightly reducing the odds of Demi Gauntlet spawning on very early enemies.
[*][b]Tangrels:[/b] Replacing "No Flank" with "Health Expert".
[*][b]Deep Wounds:[/b] This passive will now apply to all Regular Attacks, rather than just critical hits.
[*][b]Snack Stash:[/b] Now will only select a Buff that the target doesn't already have, so there should always be 2 buffs used, unless there's no more buffs to cast.
[*][b]Weapons:[/b] Switching around the Ebony Dagger and Kunai, so that the 1/2 Dark mod is "early into the game" rather than at its current tier.
[*][b]Weapons:[/b] Toothed Sword: now has a chance to inflict Bleed.
[*][b]Battle Rewards:[/b] Gold rewards will be lessened on "low level maps", the same way that AP gains are.
[*][b]Zotzits/etc:[/b] Disabling those special spawns on the maps meant to be a training ground for very low level characters (The Crossroads, etc.). Also very slightly reducing their initial spawn chance.
[*][b]Aeoths:[/b] Now will not have a cap on their HP, just like bosses. Also, they will not spawn with poison/bleed protection, to maximize "%hp damage" options to deal with them.
[*][b]Archafflictor/Therva:[/b] Their counters were exchanged, so Therva how has "Absorb Mana" and Archafflictor has "Adaptive Aegis".
[*][b]Difficulty Setting:[/b] The AP Malus Injury setting will now have a 20%/injury malus (down from 25%). And the the malus will never be greater than 60%, so a unit that died 4x in a battle will still get 40% AP.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Skull Crusher:[/b] This mace had an incorrect price (an extra 0 snuck at the end of the price). Fixed :)
[*][b]Mirror Trick:[/b] Removing some abilities that would cause problems from the list abilities that can be copied.
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Fixed a few "sprite ordering" issues on various maps.
[*][b]Sabotage:[/b] Sabotage was changed from being a "healing" ability to an offensive one that won't trigger counters on allies. Making sure it bypasses all counters correctly.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Fixing a glitch where changing the direction of sprites could have some odd layering for some rare sprites (usually, those with a beard).
[*][b]Doppelganger:[/b] Fixing an issue where Infused Edge wouldn't be useable after being copied.
[*][b]Zotzits/etc:[/b] On certain maps, they could spawn in unreachable locations. Fixed.
[*][b]Phoenix Ring:[/b] Fixing a rare case where the ring wouldn't be active at the start of an encounter.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Store:[/b] When at the store, or in the troops menu, and listing the classes that could equip a piece of gear, the box will now accommodate all classes correctly, even if the user added "a lot of them".
[*][b]Stats Caps:[/b] The stat caps for hp/mp/stats/speed/level can now be adjusted in the GameOptions.txt file. Without redoing the Level Range of encounters, changing the level cap will probably not yield anything too useful, but otherwise changing these values should be fine.

notes.title: Build 0.9.0 - Biggest update yet - Optional Content Galore + Price update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/8d430b6e3350598a0926e17da4cc2356d4780b43.png[/img]
[I]A new secret encounter.[/I]

[h1]New Build:[/h1]
Hello everyone!

We have a big update today, our [b]biggest yet[/b]!
With our Release date just around the corner, we're wrapping up all the content we want to get in and this update has (almost) all of it! 

We also have important news about the price tag. The price for the game will be increased on Monday 18th from $19.99 USD (16.99 EUR) to $29.99 USD (24.99 EUR). This price is final and will remain the same even after the game leaves early access. With the current 10% off and lower price, there has never been a better time to get the time than [b]NOW[/b]!

Let's list what it's missing, as that will be a much shorter list:
[list]
[*]The current build stops a short ways before the game's end, which means our 2 different ending are not accessible. Those will only be accessible in Release.
[*]We have a big 7 levels secret dungeon in the works, with a special boss, special loot, etc. That will only be added at Release as well.
[*]Steam cloud saves and achievements. That will be added either for the Release build or a little before.
[/list]

And that's it for the missing content. Everything else is in this build.

Now, onto what we're adding today! Here are the [b]highlights[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Story-Character Events:[/b] Adding 5 new story-character events.
[*][b]Reiner:[/b] Reiner's story class is in. It will be unlocked through a special story event.
[*][b]Optional Content:[/b] We're adding 3 secret optional battles with special rewards.
[*][b]Obelisks:[/b] A number of obelisks are hidden throughout the world in some battle maps. Each one of them yields a part of a large riddle. Finding all of them, and solving the riddle, will lead you to a big treasure.
[*][b]Special Enemies:[/b] Adding special enemies that will randomly spawn during Patrols. These enemies will award a big bonus of AP or components if you manage to defeat them before they flee the battle.
[*][b]Extra Enemies:[/b] The "extra enemies" difficulty option has been fully setup. All maps that should have extra spawns now have them.
[/list]

With all this content in, the game experience should be pretty close to what it'll look like on Release day, barring the balance changes we have planned. We'll be very eager to get everyone's feedback during our balancing/polish phase, to make sure everything is as great as it can be!

So please, don't be shy, and [b]let us know what you think[/b]! :)


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
With Release approaching so fast, we've been focusing on handling any loose ends we have.
We're adding polish to cutscenes, abilities, menus, etc. We're hunting down and fixing any bugs we have in our list that haven't been fixed yet.
We also started work on the first wave of big balance changes we have planned, although that isn't ready for primetime yet.

Starting today, our main focus is going to be polish, balance and bug fixes. This includes various UI improvements that we've add planned for a while too.
Second to that, adding the Steam Integration (cloud saves, achievements) and finally, wrapping up our optional secret dungeon.

[h1]New Content Preview:[/h1]
Here's what some of the new optional content looks like, to help everyone get started!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/c46ae85bce5af881e6920fc701f42a00d60066fe.png[/img]
[I]The first Obelisk you can find.[/I]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/bb34d7f1fc6bce8fbbce77bf1c568ea7a59b28f8.png[/img]
[I]The Zotzits give a big AP bonus based on the monster tier. This story battle is the first time you can encounter one. They will start randomly spawning in Patrols from then on.[/I]


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]03/15/2019 - Version 0.9.0[/u]
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Story-Character Events:[/b] Adding 5 new story-character events.
[*][b]Reiner:[/b] Reiner's story class is in. It will be unlocked through a special story event.
[*][b]Secret Character:[/b] It's possible we added a secret character that's fairly difficult to unlock...
[*][b]Optional Battles:[/b] We added 3 secret optional battles with some quests to unlock them.
[*][b]Patrols:[/b] Adding a lot of new patrols.
[*][b]Iirzk'tara Gorge:[/b] A new enemy was added to this map. Normally you would encounter him during your story battle there, but for people already past that content, you might want to go back there and check it out.
[*][b]Obelisks:[/b] A number of obelisks are hidden throughout the world in some battle maps. Each one of them yields a part of a large riddle. Finding all of them, and solving the riddle, will lead you to a big treasure.
[*][b]Zotzits:[/b] We added a special enemy, the Zotzit, that randomly spawns during patrols after a specific point in the story. If you manage to defeat them before they run, you will be awarded with a large AP bonus.
[*][b]Bandit Kawa:[/b] We added another special enemy that randomly spawns during patrols. Defeating them before they flee will yield rare crafting components and weapons.
[*][b]Extra Enemies:[/b] The "extra enemies" difficulty option has been fully setup. All maps that should have extra spawns now have them.
[*][b]Outfits:[/b] Adding some outfits/hats that only become accessible after completing certain quests in game.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Bosses:[/b] Bosses (and some other special characters) will now ignore the "extra gear" flag when it comes to generating accessories in empty slots, to prevent them from spawning with boots and status immunities they are not supposed to have.
[*][b]Somier:[/b] In a battle involving Somier, some adjustments were made to make sure his level always matches the player's. Also weakening a few enemies and ensuring some of them will not spawn with boots when they shouldn't on any difficulty setting.
[*][b]Encounters:[/b] Many encounters have had small tweaks made to them, usually to make them a little easier. The "Extra Enemies" option brings all those maps to the same difficulty as before, or higher (usually higher, haha).
[*][b]Counter: Mute:[/b] Changing the counter so it works on attacks from all ranges instead of only "ranged attacks". The goal is to make the trigger conditions of counters more uniform across the board.
[*][b]Weapons:[/b] Crossbow "Willam's" now gives +10% accuracy.
[*][b]Arena:[/b] Changing the arena fight bonus from +50% GP to +33% GP/AP, to account better for the increased difficulty of the battles. Let us know how that works for you!
[*][b]AI:[/b] Adding new functionalities to the AI weights system so different weights can be added to specific targets (this helps get the AI to prioritize certain allies for heals/buffs). These will be made available to modders soon.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Next/Prev Enemies/Allies:[/b] When using the buttons to quickly switch to the previous/next enemy/ally in combat, if the cursor is already on a valid target, the cursor lookup will start on that target. This eliminates the issue where the "next target" is the same as the "current one" so the button press does nothing the 1st time.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Cleaning up the description of a few abilities to be more accurate.
[*][b]Extra Enemies:[/b] Enemies spawned by the Added Enemies difficulty setting will show "Extra" on their information panel in combat rather than "Enemy", for clarity.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Crash:[/b] Fixing a very rare crash that could happen when canceling a cutscene.
[*][b]Visual Glitch:[/b] Fixing a rare visual glitch where a dagger using enemy could spawn with a weapon with no name and a missing icon.
[*][b]Infused Edge:[/b] Fixing an issue where the predicted damage from the spell part of the attack would account for the critical damage (so the player could tell if the spell was going to be a critical hit).
[*][b]Learn Ability:[/b] The list where all known classes are shown could sometimes show the wrong selected class at times after a lot of class had been unlocked by a user.
[*][b]Flying and Water:[/b] Fixing some visual oddities when flying in/out of water without the Float status.
[*][b]Revives:[/b] Enemies that started their turn in water would revive other enemies in their starting position if they decided to revive on that turn.
[*][b]Water:[/b] Not applying anymore the bonus/malus to being in water if having the status Float.
[*][b]Sprite Priorities:[/b] Fixing various priority of drawing for sprites/maps on various maps.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Errors:[/b] Adding more error checking for spawning enemies through Encounters.txt.
[*][b]Encounters.txt:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Adding "shield" as an argument for spawning humans, to decide their shield (true, false, "item code"). This was already covered by "weapon2", but it's a little clearer now.
[*]Changing the "shield", "helmet" and "armor" tags so that putting an accessory in them will now work.
[*]Adding "noitems:true", to make a specific enemy unable to use items.
[/list]
[/list]

Edit: Hotfix notes:
[u]03/15/2019 - Version 0.9.0a[/u]
[h1]Hotfix:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Ekidna Falls:[/b] The Seal there got its orientation changed at some point. Fixed.
[*][b]Plains01:[/b] Missing a collision on a tile there. Fixed.
[*][b]Bandit Kawa:[/b] They were using the wrong AI script. Fixed. They might be a little hard to catch now though. Let us know what you think!
[/list]
