notes.title: Build 0.5.0 - New Content update, Balance update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/10029a6acd817b4d7a3133c12ef85739459c6aae.gif[/img]
[I]Sneak Peek at one of our new spell in the works.[/I]


Hello everyone!

This week, we're releasing our [b]next chunk of new content[/b], along with a lot of balance tune-ups and a big dialogues update.

Here are the highlights of the build:

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Story Content:[/b] Adding 4 new story encounters, 3 new patrols, 1 optional small event.
[*][b]Dialogues:[/b] All dialogues in the game were reviewed/updated by writer Scott Hamm. We have a proofreading pass coming at the end of the month, and then they should be final.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Lots of AI improvements again.
[*][b]Balance:[/b] Balance updates for many classes, including abilities and requirements.
[/list]

Full notes are in the build and at the end of this post, as usual.


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
First, a big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone for all the incredible feedback we've been getting on the game! We made another big round of balance tuning from it and it's looking better than ever!
We have several pages of balance notes that still need to go in though, so expect even more improvements in the coming months!

We spent a lot of time testing and tuning this week and we started the final dialogue editing process. We have about 70% of the dialogues in what should be pretty much final form after writer Scott Hamm finished his giant pass on them. We'll still be focusing for 2 more weeks on creating the rest of the game's dialogues, then it'll be updated by Scott again, and then off to localization.
We're keeping a good pace on that front and we're on schedule. :)

We're also about 95% finished with the Voice Over for our intro movie. It's looking and sounding amazing and we can't wait to show everyone the final version! It should be ready Monday or Tuesday, so expect a quick update early next week!

Lately, we've been working on maps for optional/secret dungeons as well as the final battles of the game, so we can't quite show all of them, but here's one that should be safe to show:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/2dde575fa0eb9d3c2a091759b238cd93f4fbab3e.gif[/img]

Lastly, we've been working on the visuals for the abilities of one of our special classes. They should have a pretty unique style! (like the one at the top of this post).


[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]11/16/2018 - Version 0.5.0[/u]
[h1]New Content and Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Story Content:[/b] Adding 4 new story encounters, 3 new patrols, 1 optional small event.
[*][b]Dialogues:[/b] All dialogues in the game were reviewed/updated by writer Scott Hamm. We have a proofreading pass coming at the end of the month, and then they should be final.
[*][b]Cutscenes:[/b] A few cutscenes had minor updates.
[*][b]Sound Effects:[/b] Adding sound effects to many abilities.
[*][b]Outfits:[/b] Adding a new outfit to the game for males. The female version should be ready in a bit.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Map balance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Alpine Woods: Making one of the Daodrenners a "more enemies" option.
[*]Gyaum Tor: Making one of the Mercenaries a "more enemies" option.
[*]The Highlands: If the character doesn't have 7 units in total, one of the Vangals won't spawn.
[*]Yates Cabin: Changing the player spawning tiles to make things a little easier.
[*]The Banyan: Changing on the Rangers to be a "more enemies" option.
[*]2nd Temple: Changing the Wizard to be a "more enemies" option.
[*]Ekhidna Falls: Changing the component yield on the 0,5 tree to 2 (from 1).
[/list]
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] Changing Hard mode to use "more enemies" and "regular stats" and Very Hard to use "Regular Injuries".
[*][b]Berserk:[/b] Reducing duration to 2 turns (from 3).
[*][b]Thorns:[/b] Thorns damage will not apply to counters anymore (when a counter hits a target with thorn, thorn will not reflect a portion of the counter damage).
[*][b]Self Buff Counters:[/b] Those will not proc if the effect is already on the target (which means that damaging dispels won't trigger them anymore).
[*][b]Smart Casting:[/b] Disabling Smart Casting for all Single target attacks.
[*][b]Consumables:[/b] Reducing the vertical range of many items to 5 (they all had 8 before).
[*][b]Story Characters:[/b] Story characters that depart from the party will receive some bonus AP to basic classes after they rejoin. New story characters that join will get more AP when joining.
[*][b]Demon Knight:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Demonic Might: Adding Renew to the effects. 
[*]Vicious Punt: Lowering damage to 0.85 but increasing vert range to 4.
[*]Vicious Slash: Increasing vert range to 4.
[*]Cleave: Cleave won't grant 10MP on the bonus turn anymore.
[/list]
[*][b]Ranger:[/b] Increasing vert range of Multishot (6 to 7). Increasing damage of Rain Of Arrows (.85 to .9).
[*][b]Knight:[/b] Exchanging Taunt and Defensive Hit positions on the skill tree.
[*][b]Warmage:[/b]
[list]
[*]Requirements: Changed to Plague Doctor-3, Fellblade-4
[*]Stasis Burst: Removing it from the Warmage. The ability doesn't fit very well with their kit and they still have 10 without it.
[/list]
[*][b]Scoundrel:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sneak Attack: Adding a MP cost of 6.
[*]Steal abilities: Steal abilities that deal no damage will not trigger most counters anymore.
[/list]
[*][b]Fellblade:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Sleep Slice: Increasing the MP cost to 12 from 8, reducing damage from 0.8x (from 0.85x)
[*]Poison, Bleed Slice: Reducing damage to 0.85x (from 0.9x).
[*]Mute Slice: Reducing damage to 0.9x (from 0.95x).
[*]Black Blade: Damage is now non-elemental rather than Dark.
[*]Health Siphon: Damage is now non-elemental rather than Physical.
[*]Miasma: Reducing range to 2 (from 3), increasing damage to 0.6x (from 0.5x), increasing vert range to 7 (from 6) and changing shape to Square (from Cross).
[/list]
[*][b]Werewolf:[/b]
[list]
[*]Leap: Updated how it works. Give it a go to see just how it works! The visual effect is temporary as it's missing the damage visuals, but the functionality is there.
[*]Fetid Breath: Is now a cone (it was meant to be a cone, so it was technically a bug).
[*]Gear: Adding swords to the list of weapons.
[/list]
[*][b]Plague Doctor:[/b]
[list] 
[*]Treatment: Reducing MP cost of Treatment to 8 (from 10).
[*]Mass Slow: Increasing base success rate from 50% to 75%
[*]Weaken: Increasing base success rate from 75% to 100%. More changes will come to make this spell more attractive soon.
[/list]
[*][b]Assassin:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sleep Powder: Increasing vert range of to 1 (from 0).
[*]Dispel Powder: Adding 0.6x damage to it.
[/list]
[*][b]Druid:[/b]
[list]
[*]Requirements: Changing to Mender-3, Wizard-5, Alchemystic-3
[*]Dispel: Changing MP cost to 8 (from 10) and range to 3 (from 2).
[/list]
[*][b]Gadgeteer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Requirements: Reducing to Scoundrel-3 (from 4) and Wizard-3 (from 4).
[*]Dispelotron: Reducing MP cost to 8 (from 10).
[/list]
[*][b]Peddler:[/b] Can now equip crossbows.
[*][b]Duelist:[/b] Increasing elemental Flourish damage to 1.7x from 1.6x. And Cripple Flourish to 0.9x from 0.85f.
[*][b]Gunner:[/b] Changing requirement to Mercenary-4, Knight-4, Ranger-4
[*][b]Sorcerer:[/b] Changing requirements to Druid-5
[*][b]Templar:[/b] Adding MP cost of 8 to Soothing Chant.
[*][b]Human Classes:[/b] Lowering the MP growth of most classes.
[*][b]Bzaro:[/b] Starting Bzaro with the Daodrenner class unlocked as well.
[*][b]Rakkerjak:[/b] Changing passive from Cleave to Execute (that was actually a bug).
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Updated the elemental resistances of most demonic creatures (mostly the Dark element).
[*][b]Bulldrakes:[/b] Increasing base stats. Increasing damage to Breath attacks.
[*][b]AI:[/b]
[list]
[*]The AI will instantly switch targets if its current target moves to a spot where the AI could never follow (due to height issues, etc), rather than sadly follow it for a few turns.
[*]Revive Items: The AI will now have a chance to use Revive items at times.
[*]AI will be less likely to shove targets into their allies when using long ranged shoves.
[*]AI will be smarter about including allies when buffing itself with AoEs.
[*]AI will be less likely to self buff if it has the special "waiting for the player to get closer" flag.
[*]AI will be smarter about using abilities that have scaling damage with proximity to the target.
[/list]
[*][b]Equipment:[/b]
[list]
[*] Vigil Band: Adding the Vigil Band, an accessory that protects against Sleep.
[*] Judogi: Reducing Armor value.
[*] Silver Helm: Changed the ATK bonus to a MND (it was always meant to be MND).
[*] Main Gauche: Increasing ATK value. Also reducing the chance of enemies using it.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Azure Plains:[/b] Making the tall grass 85% opacity so the movement tiles can be seen through them. It's still hard to see, but it should be more obvious where you can move to this way.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Cleaning up and adding details to a lot of abilities information.
[*][b]Special Classes:[/b] When prompted to use a Badge to learn a special class, the prompt will now mention how many badges you have in total.
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] Renaming "Easy" to "Beginner". Updating the description of Veteran to make it clearer the battles will be challenging for most players.
[*][b]Help Compendium:[/b] Fixing typos. Adding missing camp fire sprites to the background.
[*][b]System Menu:[/b] The Start button/Key will now close the menu (as well as the Cancel Button/Key).
[*][b]Accuracy:[/b] When an attack or a debuff has 0% to hit, the 0% will now be written in Red (rather than white) to make it more obvious.
[*][b]HP/MP Bar:[/b] The bar wasn't precise at low levels. Fixing it so it's accurate now.
[*][b]Items:[/b] Updating the Items command description to mention they are shared and refill automatically.
[*][b]Fullscreen:[/b] Changing the behavior of the game to remain "Visible in Background", as it seems to be the default recommended behavior. Sadly, Unity doesn't allow this behavior to be changed at runtime as it should, so we have to pick one or the other.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Abilities Learn Menu:[/b] Fixing issue with character panel not updating when switching characters from the Ability Learn menu.
[*][b]Mouse/Kb:[/b] Fixing: Mouse wheel icon could remain visible when it shouldn't if using the keyboard rather than the mouse.
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] Fixing an issue where starting a game on a different difficulty setting than the default one, quitting the game and starting a new game would show the wrong difficulty setting name.
[*][b]MP Values:[/b] After switching passives or before deployment in combat, the current MP value of characters can show the wrong value at times (this is cosmetic, as the correct MP is always used in combat).
[*][b]Various Maps:[/b] Fixing priorities that were a little wonky on many maps.
[*][b]Bzaro:[/b] Fixing a bug were Bzaro would start with most classes unlocked.
[*][b]Debuffs:[/b] Now correctly showing that Barrier was removed when a Counter: Debuff is triggered by a character with Barrier on.
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Fixing rare case where Gear or Badges crafting categories would be flagged as unavailable after browsing components.
[*][b]Sound:[/b] Fixing a caching issue with the sound effects.
[*][b]Crash:[/b] Fixing a rare crash with Adaptative Affinity.
[*][b]StealTables:[/b] Fixing a bug where enemies that spawn during battle all had an empty steal table.
[*][b]Charge:[/b] Charge abilities can now correctly hit targets in the water, assuming the charge itself doesn't go into the water.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Encounters:[/b] The "apbonus" field can be used on enemies to have them grant a flat AP bonus to the player if they were killed during the battle.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.4.4 - Help Compendium
notes.notes:
We've been busy wrapping up our dialogues, so we have only a small update this week. 

The main addition is the [b]Help Compendium[/b]. It has explanations on all the systems, tips for beginners and advanced tips. Give it a look and let us know if you think anything is missing!

It's accessible from the System menu (so, from the world map or during battle) and it's called "Help Compendium".

As usual, the full patch notes are at the end of the post.


[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]
As we've mentioned, we've been focusing on wrapping up all dialogues, so that's where most of our progress has been. But, we've also been working on new sounds, new maps and new abilities visuals. Here's some of them.

A new map that should be used for a secret optional dungeon:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/96d6637fa804253fedb77fb4caf3dbe95d9e0fc1.gif[/img]

A spell for a new enemy type that isn't in the game quite yet:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/3e8bb44bf052b91e6b45edbfc906f83c68cdbddc.gif[/img]

We've been working on new spells for one of our secret classes, so you should expect some cool visuals coming in soon! Also, we're almost done adding the Voice Over for our intro movie, so keep your eyes peeled for that one too. It's sounding pretty awesome with the VO! :)


[h1]Announcement:[/h1]
We'll be at [I]Free Play Florida[/I] later today and over the week-end. If you're in the area, come say hello!

[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[u]11/09/2018 - Version 0.4.4[/u]
[h1]New Content and Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Help Compendium:[/b] Adding the Help Compendium section to the System menu. It's accessible from the worldmap or during battle. The Help Compendium has a lot of information about many systems.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Updating Health Siphon, Vicious Blow and Rend. Adding Wrathful Blow, One for All and Enraged Blow.
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI will now use One for All if it has access to it and it thinks it's a good move.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] Adding various small improvements to the AI to make it a little smarter.
[*][b]AI:[/b] For AIs that have Teleport Other, they will now try to teleport targets onto traps if they can't drown anyone.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Ranged units will be less prone to charge forward after attacking.
[*][b]Drakesmouth Seaway:[/b] Making one of the 2 Gunners a "More Enemies" option spawn only.
[/list]

[h1]UI:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Ability Learn Menu:[/b] Now showing the character's information panel on the screen where you can select which class to learn abilities, for more clarity.
[*][b]Turn Order bar:[/b] Cleaning up the way the currently selected character is shown on the bar to be more consistent.
[*][b]EXP Sequence:[/b] Making sure the character is always on screen when showing their EXP (with very long range attacks, they could be out of the screen at times).
[*][b]Counter: Teleport Other:[/b] It shouldn't teleport people to spots on the map that are very isolated anymore.
[*][b]Titlescreen:[/b] Adding a back button option from the difficulty settings after selecting "New Game".
[*][b]Thespeiros:[/b] The map objective states the Guest must suvive, but no gameover came if they die. This is fixed now.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Accuracy:[/b] Base accuracy is now 100% rather than 99%. Most enemies have 1% evasion, so it's still 99% unless you have Glasses/Passive. This was meant to be in a few patches ago, so it's technically a bug.
[*][b]Cleave:[/b] If the current character has the Cleave Passive and attacks a target, which gets killed by an ally's One For All, they will no longer receive a Cleave turn.
[*][b]Worm Battle:[/b] Fixing an issue where one of the corridors could be unblocked after a small worm died.
[*][b]Music:[/b] Fixing a rare problem where the battle music could fail to play at the start of some battles and the preparations music would keep playing instead.
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI will no longer try to dispel permanent buffs from targets.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Classes:[/b] Defaulting missing class outfit to 0 rather than having an error.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.4.3 - AI Update
notes.notes:
We have another build this week, this one focusing on various AI improvements and a host of small updates and bug fixes.

Here are the highlights:
[list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] Multiple improvements and fixes to the AI, covering a wide range (more details in the change log).
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Adding Crafting.xml file. It contains Ingredients, Badges, Recipes and Gadgets. Each of those can be changed or new entries can be added, using the same system as for weapons, armors, etc.
[*][b]Gamepad:[/b] Modifying the gamepad system to maximize compatibility with Xbox controllers in general. Removing the previous "Gamepad Fix" option as it is now unnecessary.
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] We added new stats scaling options last patch and forgot to mention them. They are aimed at increasing the difficulty. We do have another system in the works on that front that should be more interesting than simply higher stats, but it's not quite ready yet.
[/list]

[h1]Progress:[/h1]
Nothing fancy to report this week as we're still focusing on our dialogues for the most part. We're making good time on that front though!

We've also been hard at work creating new assets, including new sounds, new spells and new maps. Here's our latest map concept:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/6488bfa4057c01f9e227e7b90c3cfc7aece3ba63.gif[/img]

The overall plan is to keep making small balance improvements until we clear our dialogues load, then we'll take some time for a big balance update with all the feedback we've been gathering.

Keep it coming and thanks! :)


[h1][b]Change log:[/b][/h1]
[u]11/02/2018 - Version 0.4.3[/u]
[h1]New Content and features:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Adding a lot of new sounds for abilities and cutscenes.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Updating/adding visuals for many abilities, including: Bite, Bulldrake Breaths, Primal Cry and Shadow Hunt.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Difficulty Settings:[/b] We added new stats scaling options last patch and forgot to mention them. They are aimed at increasing the difficulty. We do have another system in the works on that front that should be more interesting than simply higher stats, but it's not quite ready yet.
[*][b]Yates Cabin:[/b] Reducing the difficulty of the 2nd encounter on the map by removing an enemy unless the "more enemies" difficulty setting is used.
[*][b]AI:[/b] The AI should be more aggressive with moving towards the player units and should be less prone to moving before buffing itself. 
[*][b]AI:[/b] Making the AI smarter when choosing a path towards a target they can't reach yet.
[*][b]AI:[/b] AI with Charm status should be more effective (they were prone to wasting some turns moving towards their new allies without taking action).
[*][b]AI:[/b] Various small tweaks to AI behavior to make it smarter.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Updating the pathfinding for flying creatures to be much better.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Reducing chances of "offensive units" to go buffing their allies rather than charge at the player.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Increasing the minimum range a player unit must be to an enemy trapper for them to decide to place a trap.
[*][b]Buffs/Debuffs:[/b] Making it so Stats Up/Down buffs and debuffs remove their opposite when applied, the same way haste/slow currently works. (So, applied Atk Up will remove Atk Down from the target).
[*][b]Barrier:[/b] Counter: Barrier will no longer activate if the target already had barrier at the start of the attack (so, casting a debuff on a target with Barrier and Counter: Barrier will use up the current Barrier and not recast it on the same attack).
[*][b]Knee Shot:[/b] Reducing damage to 0.85x from 0.9x. Also renaming to Rooting Shot.
[*][b]Thespeiros Encounter:[/b] The guest helping on this map will start using recovery items once no other actions can be taken.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Small tweaks to some monsters abilities (spell to skill, etc). Adding a MP cost of 12 to Rest Up.
[*][b]Charm:[/b] Charm ability MP cost increased from 6 to 16 and chance up to 100%. Increasing chance of Allure to 75% base (from 62%).
[*][b]Charm Debuf:[/b] Charm debuff duration lowered to 2 turns (from 3).
[*][b]Focused Rage:[/b] Increasing the damage per MP converted from 2% to 2.5%. Also including the damage conversion ratio in the description.
[/list]

[h1]UI and Visuals:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Gamepad:[/b] Modifying the gamepad system to maximize compatibility with Xbox controllers in general. Removing the previous "Gamepad Fix" option as it is now unnecessary.
[*][b]Gamepad:[/b] Adding an option to use specific icons for the gamepad. Current selection is: Auto, Xbox360, Xbox One, Ps4, Steam Controller.
[*][b]Projectiles:[/b] Speeding up projectiles (arrows, bolts, etc) travel speeds by quite a bit.
[*][b]Graveyard Story Battle:[/b] Making a certain character immune to Sleep so they aren't slept during the quick dialogue cutscene during battle.
[*][b]Critical Hits:[/b] Adding a screenshake to critical hits to make them more impactful.
[*][b]Charm, Sleep, Berserk:[/b] Updating help tooltips to show that only one of these debuffs can be on at once. Updating visuals during damage phase to correctly show if a previous debuff was removed by a new one.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Rebirth:[/b] Rebirth will now correctly trigger if a character dies by being countered to death.
[*][b]Rebirth:[/b] Fixing an issue where Rebirth might not trigger on the target when killed by a Dual Wielding regular attack.
[*][b]One for All:[/b] Fixing a bug where One for All would trigger from Counterattack and Counter: Magic.
[*][b]One for All:[/b] One for all will now correctly trigger Counters on the person attacked and also won't bypass Rebirth anymore.
[*][b]Spiked Glove:[/b] The description box now correctly shows "None" as the stat that will defend against it.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Fixing an issue where Gadgeteers AI sometimes didn't get access to the correct gadgets.
[*][b]Evasion:[/b] Fixing a bug where the base evasion of units was listed as 0 but was internally 1.
[*][b]Events:[/b] Fixing incorrect text being shown on the worldmap after finishing the 3rd Temple.
[*][b]Counter Steal:[/b] Fixing an issue where Counter: Steal would sometimes fail to trigger when it should.
[*][b]Height Advantage:[/b] Fixing an issue where the bonus from Height Advantage would be incorrect under many circumstances.
[/list]

[h1]Modding:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Adding Crafting.xml file. It contains Ingredients, Badges, Recipes and Gadgets. Each of those can be changed or new entries can be added, using the same system as for weapons, armors, etc. Each item can only have 1 recipe for it though, so keep that in mind.
[/list]


[h1]Hotfixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Wrathful Blow[/b]: Fixing Wrathful Blow acting weirdly.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Tweaking the AI so it won't use Rest Up as soon as possible every time for Bulldrakes.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Adding a flag to abilities not meant as a healing spell but that have a weak bonus healing component. The AI won't try to heal itself with those anymore since they're not meant for healing.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Fixing a bug where the AI could do a movement after falling asleep under rare circumstances.
[*][b]AI:[/b] Making a full HP AI less likely to back away from the player units if they are of a style that enjoys doing melee attacks.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.4.2 - Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone :)

We have another update this week, which features a [b]Halloween[/b] themed encounter, with a special reward. Give it a try, it should prove to be challenging!

To check it out, you'll have to finish the last battle of the current build (the one in [I]Drakesmouth Seaway[/I]). Don't worry, we won't remove the encounter after Halloween, so you'll be able to try it later if you haven't reached that point yet.

The update also has a bunch of bug fixes as well as UI and balance improvements. Here are the highlights:

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Battle:[/b] Adding a new Halloween themed encounter once the Drakesmouth Seaway encounter is completed (it will be red on the map, although it is not a mandatory story encounter). It should be difficult and has a special reward.
[*][b]Patch Notes:[/b] Adding the Patch notes directly to the client from the title screen.
[*][b]Intro Video:[/b] Updating the video with the correct music. Just missing the VO now!
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Updating/adding visuals for Multishot, Critical Expertise, Mirage, Counter Mirage, Counter Barrier, Sedate, Phantasm, Steal GP, Boomerang Toss and Nameless One.
[*][b]Movements:[/b] When using Show Details in battle, all enemies movements will be shown in blue to quickly see the "dangerous" areas.
[*][b]Difficulty Stats Scaling:[/b] Fixing an issue where many enemies would not spawn with the correct stats scaling. This should impact both easier and harder difficulties.
[/list]

As always, the full notes are at the end of the post.

[h1]Progress:[/h1]
There isn't a whole lot of new things to report this week. We're still focusing on getting all our dialogues fully written so we can have a big review of them and then start the localization process. We're focusing on new maps, story events and dialogues right now and this will remain the case for a while still.

We have a few new maps for optional content in the works, like this one:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/c4caff3caad1aeb217aee3840704f6588ecbcc27.gif[/img]

In terms of new art, we have another spell for the Vessel class and this is what it looks like:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/596cb1068635e74bf1e95272c5a5c9960782c250.gif[/img]


Lastly, we have a bunch of Halloween themed assets that we've been creating recently and those should all be part of the Halloween encounter we're adding in this update. Here's some nifty art one of our contracted artists made to celebrate Halloween:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30514749/5d1f4364b9a4842450507fd4e6528a11cd3f240a.png[/img]


[h1]Full Change log:[/h1]

[u]10/26/2018 - Version 0.4.2[/u]
[h1]New Content and features:[/h1]
[list][*][b]New Battle:[/b] Adding a new Halloween themed encounter once the Drakesmouth Seaway encounter is completed (it will be red on the map, although it is not a mandatory story encounter). It should be difficult and has a special reward.
[*][b]Patch Notes:[/b] Adding the Patch notes directly to the client from the title screen.
[*][b]Intro Video:[/b] Updating the video with the correct music. Just missing the VO now.
[*][b]Equipment:[/b] Adding new accessory Glasses that gives +10% accuracy.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Updating/adding visuals for Multishot, Critical Expertise, Mirage, Counter Mirage, Counter Barrier, Sedate, Phantasm, Steal GP, Boomerang Toss and Nameless One.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Somier now has a different sprite/portrait to other Kawas.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Adding ElvensEarsHorns and Horns hats for the player to use.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Adding Vampire portrait.
[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Abilities:[/b] Giving a MP cost to One for All of 16 MP. 
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Changing cost of Shock box to 24 from 28 MP.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Coalesce will not cause an injury for the user anymore.
[*][b]Abilities:[/b] Skyjack will no longer drop targets into the water. Skyjack will always do a minimum of 1 damage.
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] Removing Boon and Focus effect from a character when they die.
[*][b]Monsters:[/b] Increasing Pektites RES a bit.
[*][b]Passives:[/b] Into the Fray will now grant an increasingly larger bonus based on the amount of adjacent targets (before: 0.125x to 0.5x. Now 0.125x to 0.85x depending on the amount of targets around).
[*][b]Item Usage:[/b] Increasing the level needed for the AI to gain access to powerful healing items (so they will get them later).
